observations: slender rounded scaleless brown body with a blunt snout and tiny lateral eyes

identification_limits: The supplied Swamp eel / Ikan belut follows the inspected regional Monopterus javanensis reference; the older Monopterus albus name covers a species complex. Broad ordinary fish fins are omitted rather than invented; no certified stock identification or terrestrial movement is claimed.
